settings.title: Simulation settings
settings.subtitle: Defaults are ready — you can start without opening Advanced Settings.
settings.lockedHint: Settings are locked while a run is active. Changes only apply to a new run.
settings.noServers: No servers found. Add and verify a server first, then come back to run a simulation.
settings.noOnlineServer: No ONLINE server is available, so the simulation cannot start. Wait until a server comes online or check its status.
settings.monitorOnlyHint: Decisions will be recorded, but traffic will mostly be allowed according to policy.
settings.intensityHint: Controls the persona weights used in the simulation
settings.targetRpsHint: Average target rate (the worker adds jitter)
settings.maxRpsCapHint: Safety ceiling for the request rate
settings.weightsDefaultsHint: Weights shown here are the defaults of {{pattern}}. Use Customize to edit them (switches the pattern to custom).
settings.personaWeightsHint: Weights (0–100) are converted to percentages during the run
settings.additionalOptionsHint: Optional overrides for IP pools, AI mode, seed and preferred paths
settings.ipPoolLegitHint: IPs used to simulate legitimate visitors
settings.seedHint: Empty = random. Same settings + same seed = same distribution
settings.aiFixedScoreHint: 0 – 1 · used when AI mode is fixed
settings.enableJaHeadersHint: Send JA3/JA4 when the worker and gateway support it
